description: Analyze supplied GPX/FIT directly with the browser's canonical pipeline; no catalog search or runner profile is needed. Accept inline course_file, URL, or artifact source. Existing CRSProf is preserved and summarized. Returns job plus a bounded structured summary, units, missing-data warnings and complete CRSProf artifact. Defaults: moving threshold 0.25 m/s, minimum stop 30 s, merge distance 60 m with combined-speed guard. Detected stop elapsed may include short moving portions; it is not total non-moving time. No timestamp means no invented pace/time. Hosted clients without file-byte access or direct upload connectivity should send the user to the fixed page https://courseprofiler.com/agent-upload.html. The page creates the private upload session; the user copies the returned artifact ID into chat. MCP does not create a session-specific browser link. Inspect job.status/errors; this call currently runs analysis synchronously. Optional idempotency {key, caller_token} requires the server feature enabled; API keys are optional. Persist the private caller/key before submission, use get_activity_submission to reconcile, and never switch to a fresh key to bypass an unresolved outcome.

course_file.description: Inline GPX/FIT content or base64; use an artifact from agent-upload.html if the client cannot read bytes.

name.description: Original file name, e.g. course.gpx or runner.usrprof.

url.description: Fetchable HTTPS URL to file bytes. Do not use file:// or bare local paths. ZIP is accepted only when it contains exactly one GPX file.

caller_token.description: Anonymous callers: private stable 32-byte cryptographic random token, unpadded base64url. Preserve before submitting; never expose in URLs/logs. Omit for API-key identity.

key.description: Stable per-submission random key. Same caller/key/input replays; changed input conflicts. Never reuse expired keys.

activity_role.description: Optional explicit intent for GPX/FIT. Plan produces geometry only and rejects execution thresholds; Execution requires source timing. Omit for legacy auto-detection. Existing CRSProf is preserved with analysis_options_not_applied; its role is not changed.

algorithm.description: Omitted: SLOPE_BASED for explicit Plan geometry; otherwise PACE_BASED for timestamped input and SLOPE_BASED for untimed routes. Explicit Plan rejects PACE_BASED.

auto_stop_merge_distance.description: Merge distance in metres; combined interval must remain below or at moving threshold.

auto_stop_threshold.description: Minimum detected stop seconds; zero disables detection.

expected_implementation.description: Requires explicit role and durable idempotency. V3 binds requested fields; omitted and explicit defaults differ. Matching is not processing approval. Rejections are replayed original terminal outcomes, never fresh-key retry permission.

requested_numeric_contract.description: Opt-in fingerprint v4: exact requested numeric tokens for the three analysis controls, without changing double calculations. Requires pin, role and durable key. Maximum 100 token characters, absolute explicit exponent 30 and absolute decimal scale 60; duplicate keys reject. Omission preserves v1-v3 behavior.

artifact_id.description: Existing CourseProfiler artifact ID, e.g. art_...

base64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes for raw_file inputs, suitable for FIT or other binary files.

content.description: Inline text file content for raw_file inputs, suitable for GPX/XML/JSON/USRProf.

content_type.description: MIME type for inline raw_file content.

file_name.description: File name for inline raw_file content, e.g. course.gpx or runner.usrprof.

payload.description: Inline raw JSON payload for CRSProf/USRProf-compatible inputs.

url.description: Fetchable public URL to a GPX, FIT, CRSProf, USRProf, or evidence file. For course inputs, prefer official direct GPX/FIT/CRSProf URLs over generic race homepages, but stop and ask the user to download/upload when the host blocks server fetches (for example 403 from Wikiloc or other route hosts). Do not synthesize course geometry from roadbooks, checkpoint tables, or elevation profiles.

If expired, call get_artifact for a fresh URL. This applies only to artifact download_url values, not authorization or upload links.

Bound means exact source/result binding, not complete applicability, processing approval, source currency or publication authority. Writer enforces 24576 UTF-8 bytes; stage trace 16000 bytes. Missing evidence never authorizes reanalysis. Replay retains original evidence unchanged.
